original_test_intent: Verify BMC-local DRAM remains stable for more than 12 hours under U-Boot dramtest 0 at 0C and +5% 5V/3.3V rails, then confirm normal BMC firmware and services recover.
original_method: Identify BMC/board/U-Boot and approved console; preserve firmware, boot variables and logs; validate dramtest 0 memory range, destructive semantics, progress and return behavior; control humidity/dew point, cold-soak and measured +5% rails; capture an uninterrupted >12-hour console run with independent supervision; exit/reset through the approved path, warm safely and verify firmware boot, network, sensors and logs at nominal conditions.
manual_activity: Operator controls console/chamber/rails, supervises the bootloader test and returns BMC to production firmware.
required_inputs: dramtest 0 syntax, memory coverage, reserved-region safety and expected output
safety_requirements: Do not run unverified bootloader memory commands
Preserve boot environment and console transcript
Abort on memory error, console loss, moisture, rail or thermal fault
Warm above dew point before chamber opening
agent_execution_scope: May inspect approved command semantics and analyze console/service artifacts
Must not enter bootloader, control chamber/rails or determine verdict
engineer_actions: Approve command range, cold profile and recovery
Validate restored BMC and determine verdict

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Synchronize the continuous bootloader transcript with dew-point/chamber/rail data and explicit production-service recovery checks.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds memory-range validation, condensation/overshoot protection, boot-state preservation and measurable recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Host memory stress or successful BMC reboot does not prove BMC-local DRAM during the cold/high-rail interval.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A non-returning or destructive bootloader command can overwrite reserved memory; console silence requires independent observation to distinguish completion, link loss and BMC hang.

independent_technical_reasoning: U-Boot memory tests vary in range and termination. Vendor semantics and independent synchronized observation are required before interpreting the outcome.
